identity.fantasy: A spectral knight who generates souls through Dreadwake, summons wardens and scythes, and turns avoidance and active pack pressure into healing and mitigation.
identity.one_line: A spectral knight who generates souls through Dreadwake, summons wardens and scythes, and turns avoidance and active pack pressure into healing and mitigation. The defining decision is contextual: Incoming pressure determines whether souls are held defensively or converted into tempo.

mechanics.core_loop: A spectral knight that generates souls through Dreadwake, summons wardens and scythes, and converts avoidance and soul states into healing and mitigation. Painmail and Eater of Souls reward staying active in packs, while Bolstered Form supplies the main defensive cycle.
mechanics.single_target: Use a single Reap, keep Tormented Souls available as a defensive resource, and cycle Dreadwake and Soul Strike. The captured guide warns against spending Tormented Souls as ordinary damage.
mechanics.aoe: Preload Tormented Souls, rush the pull, line-of-sight packs, Soul Tap, then loop Dreadwake and Soul Strike. The guide says larger pulls improve healing and runic flow, a claim limited to that author's dungeon setup.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Hybrid reach, summoned scythes, and pack-centered sustain aid control while rewarding continuous activity.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Empyrean Fortitude, Lifestealer, Behemoth, Bolstered Form, Dreadknight.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Soulsight, Ethereal Guard, Painmail.

failure_modes.text: Spending Tormented Souls offensively, entering Bolstered Form with a poor soul state, or failing to group a pull can collapse the self-healing loop.
Spending Tormented Souls as routine damage removes the reserve the guide explicitly treats as defensive.
Failing to line-of-sight and group a pull denies Dreadwake and Soul Strike the multi-target activity that feeds healing.

leveling_10_29.feel: Dreadwake, Tormentor, and avoidance establish the soul-tank identity before the late pack-healing engine is complete.
strengths: A spectral knight who generates souls through Dreadwake, summons wardens and scythes, and turns avoidance and active pack pressure into healing and mitigation.
Players and the guide emphasize strong dungeon sustain, especially when many targets feed the soul engine.
cautions: The claim that bigger pulls improve safety is plausible within the documented loop but comes from one high-progression build without controlled comparison.
Do not project the mature priority backward.
